description: This file defines a setup fixture for the Allure reporting tool in a NUnit testing environment. It ensures the results directory exists, sets environment variables, and provides a fallback output during test teardown to guarantee Allure results are captured, even if the reporter does not emit results normally.

classes.name: AllureSetup
classes.description: Contains setup and teardown logic for managing Allure reporting results directory and minimal result fallback during NUnit test execution.

methods.name: ResolveResultsDir
methods.description: Determines the directory path for Allure results based on environment variables, test parameters, or defaults to a relative path.

methods.name: GlobalSetup
methods.description: One-time setup method that ensures the results directory exists, sets environment variables, and cleans up previous results.

methods.name: GlobalTearDown
methods.description: One-time teardown method that writes a minimal Allure result to ensure at least some results are available post-test run.
